title_sq: Shitet super apartament 2+1 plus verande e mbyllur tek Pallati me Shigjeta (ID 41212092)
description_sq:
Ne zonen e Pallatit me Shigjeta, shitet super apartament 2+1 plus verande te mbyllur, buze rruge, kati i 2, ne pallat te ri me ashensor, siperfaqe apartamenti 105.4 m² bruto dhe 59.6 m² verande te mbyllur, me hipoteke, i mobiluar, parket, kondicioner, i rikonstruktuar totalisht.
Apartamenti organizohet ne: soxhorno e madhe me ambienti gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete.
E pershtatshme per banim ose per biznes si klinike, parukeri, zyre arkitekture ose marketingu etj.
Shitet 250,000 euro. (Nuk shitet me kredi)
title_en: For sale: super apartment 2+1 plus closed veranda at Palace with Arrows (ID 41212092)
description_en: In the area of ​​Palati me Shigjeta, super apartment 2+1 plus closed veranda for sale, street side, 2nd floor, in the new building with elevator, apartment area 105.4 m² gross and 59.6 m² closed veranda, with mortgage, furnished, parquet, air conditioning, completely reconstructed. The apartment is organized in: large living room with kitchen, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms. Suitable for residence or for business such as clinic, hairdresser, architectural or marketing office, etc. For sale 250,000 euros. (Not sold on credit)
